column2:
Create a weekly review system I can complete every Friday in under 30 minutes. I'm a [solopreneur / small business owner] and I need to stay on top of [everything — clients, finances, marketing, operations, personal development].
The review should include: (1) Wins — What were my 3 biggest wins this week? (2) Numbers — Key metrics to check: [suggest 5-7 for a business like mine: [describe]], (3) Pipeline — Status of all open leads/proposals, (4) Client health — Any at-risk clients or outstanding items? (5) Finances — Revenue received, invoices outstanding, upcoming expenses, (6) Content/Marketing — What was published, what's in the pipeline, any performance standouts? (7) Lessons — What would I do differently? What did I learn? (8) Next Week — Top 3 priorities + calendar review, (9) Energy audit — What drained me vs. energized me (to inform what to delegate or restructure). Format this as a fillable template I can print or copy into my notes app.
